name: Strict-Dominance Classes Are Strictly Realizable Ample
statement: Every class with $\tau=0$ is realizable ample, while the sixteen-state maximum class $C_\ast$ is realizable ample and has $\tau(C_\ast)=2^{-1/4}>0$.
proof: The coefficient-ratio criterion gives realizability exactly when $\tau<1$, so zero implies realizable ampleness. The exact spectral calibration supplies a realizable maximum class with positive value.
